en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a little girl seated at an ornate round table, writing a letter with a pen. She wears a white dress and dark shoes, with a red bow in her hair that has been hand‑tinted. Behind and above her appears a ghostly, dreamlike image of a soldier in uniform with a rifle, also partly hand‑tinted in red and blue, as if she is imagining or writing to him. The setting looks like an interior with elegant furniture. French text is printed along the bottom of the image, and a small number and a signature or publisher's mark appear near the lower edge.
